_comment_cron: Railway Cron jobs are configured on separate Cron services in the Railway dashboard (schedule + command). Both are cleanup/backstop only; correctness stays request-time authoritative (docs/spec/13).

_cron_jobs.name: expired-mock-sweep
_cron_jobs.purpose: Finalize in_progress MockAttempts whose deadline passed and were never reopened (every 15 min).

_cron_jobs.name: orphan-media-cleanup
_cron_jobs.purpose: Delete QuestionMedia rows + storage objects unreferenced by any version, after a 30-day grace period (daily).
